case_title: Labhuji Amratji Thakor & Ors. v. The State of Gujarat & Anr.
statutory_provisions: IPC s.363, s.366; POCSO Act s.3, s.4
high_court_outcome: Allowed the application under Section 319 Cr.P.C.
neutral_facts: The complainant lodged a First Information Report alleging that her daughter, a 14-year-old girl, was abducted by an accused named Natuji. The police investigated and recorded the victim's statement, which named Natuji as the perpetrator. The victim also stated that she was taken to Morbi in a jeep driven by Labhuji and that Labhuji and two other individuals were present during the journey. The victim further mentioned that she was taken to Modasa from Morbi in the same jeep. The prosecution filed an application under Section 319 Cr.P.C. to proceed against the appellants, but the trial court rejected it. The High Court allowed the application, but the Supreme Court overturned the High Court's decision, finding that the evidence did not establish the appellants' complicity in the offence.
